Definition: Year-over-year growth of company-reported turnover in RON.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Company reported +13%; the 13.3% result reconciles. Use RON series because the FY2018 EUR figure conflicts with RON (see CF-001).

Definition: Year-over-year growth of company-reported RON turnover.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Same currency, same company-reported group scope; pre-Marty consolidation. Best like-for-like growth figure available for 2024.

Definition: EUR growth of brands that were active in both years (company definition) vs 2024 group revenue.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Company states +10%. Company definition of 'existing brands' is not audited; treat as like-for-like proxy, not as audited organic growth.

Definition: EUR growth of consolidated revenue including acquired Marty Restaurants and Aubergine vs prior-year group revenue.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Inflated by acquisitions. NOT organic growth. Use only together with K03.

Definition: Revenue difference between consolidated and existing-brand scopes.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Approximates revenue of newly consolidated activities; the company does not define the bridge, so treat as indicative.

Definition: Percentage points of 2025 growth that stem from the wider consolidation scope.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Derived from K03/K04; same EUR currency.

Definition: Compound annual growth of RON turnover.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Both ends company-reported RON, group scope, before the 2024-25 acquisitions. Nominal; spans the 2022-23 inflation spike (not deflated).

KPI_Name: Revenue CAGR, 2019-2025, existing brands (RON via BNR average)
Definition: 6-year CAGR with the 2025 EUR figure converted to RON at the BNR 2025 annual average.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: FX method: BNR annual average of the end year (MA-026). Mixed reporting basis (RON in 2019, EUR in 2025). Qualified.

Definition: 3-year EUR CAGR using company-stated EUR figures.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: The 2022 EUR figure is an interview statement (grade C, Estimated). Qualified.

Definition: Growth during pandemic recovery on interview-stated EUR figures.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Both ends are Estimated (grade C); round figures. Indicative only.

Definition: Growth on interview-stated EUR figures.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Both ends Estimated (grade C). Indicative only.

Definition: Growth using the company EUR equivalent of RON 280M against the 2022 interview figure.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: 2022 base is Estimated (grade C). Indicative only.

Definition: Absolute revenue the group must add in 2026 to reach the announced EUR 100M target.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Target is consolidated; compare with consolidated 2025 only. A target is not performance.

KPI_Name: Growth required in 2026 to hit target (EUR)
Definition: Growth rate needed from the 2025 consolidated base.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Cross-check: management stated growth objective of 10-12% (CF-037/038).

KPI_Name: Growth required in 2026 to hit target (RON)
Definition: Same requirement expressed in RON, converting 2025 EUR revenue at the BNR 2025 average.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: The RON target implies about 5.0 RON/EUR (CF-036/CF-035). 'Over RON 500M' is a floor, not a point estimate.

KPI_Name: Implied FX in announced RON/EUR targets
Definition: Exchange rate implied by the two target statements.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Reconciliation of the two target figures; BNR 2026 snapshot is higher (MA-028).

KPI_Name: H1 2026 reported growth vs required growth
Definition: Gap between the H1 2026 growth reported and the full-year growth needed for the EUR 100M target.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: H1 scope and absolute H1 revenue are not published (CF-034 'scope not stated'). Negative gap means the H1 pace was below the pace the target needs; a full-year conclusion needs H2.

KPI_Name: Scope diagnostic: 10M-2025 revenue / FY2025 existing brands
Definition: Share of the full-year existing-brand revenue booked by October.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: About 85% is consistent with a typical seasonal profile (Nov-Dec about 15%) and suggests the 10M figure is on the existing-brand scope; against consolidated EUR 90M the ratio would be 71%, which is implausibly low.

KPI_Name: Company vs HORA restaurants & bars growth, 2025 (existing brands)
Definition: Percentage-point out/underperformance of like-for-like company growth against nominal growth of restaurant and bar turnover in filed accounts.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Both nominal. Industry figure is HORA analysis of filed accounts (grade C), not INS. Company scope includes hotels, events and bars.

KPI_Name: Company (consolidated) vs HORA restaurants & bars growth, 2025
Definition: Outperformance if consolidated growth were compared directly with the industry.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: UNSUITABLE: includes acquired revenue. Shown only to document why K19 is used.

KPI_Name: Company vs total HoReCa growth, 2025 (existing brands)
Definition: Comparison with the broader HoReCa aggregate (hotels, restaurants, bars, tourism agencies).
Comparability_and_Use_Note: HoReCa aggregate scope is wider than the company's. Secondary benchmark.

Definition: Nominal like-for-like growth deflated with general CPI annual average.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: General CPI used because company-specific price index is not published. Restaurant-price CPI would be higher, giving a lower real growth.

KPI_Name: Company real growth vs INS real volume index, 2025
Definition: Real company growth against INS volume-of-turnover index for hotels and restaurants.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: INS series covers market services to population (B2C) and is a volume index, not turnover. Qualified.

KPI_Name: Real company growth vs INS volume, 2024 (RON)
Definition: As K23 for 2024 using RON group revenue.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: INS 2024 figure is a gross-series yoy rate. Qualified.

Definition: Indicative share of company revenue in the HORA restaurants & bars turnover (RON 32bn).
Comparability_and_Use_Note: PROXY, not official market share: the 32bn is an approximate rounded figure from filed accounts; company revenue includes hotels, events, catering and bars; EUR to RON at BNR average.

Definition: Backed-out 2024 industry turnover from 2025 turnover and growth; company RON 339M.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: PROXY chained from a rounded estimate; the 2024 industry base is derived, not reported.

KPI_Name: Investment growth, FY2026 budget vs FY2025 actual (EUR)
Definition: Growth in planned investment against last spend.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Plan vs spend: a budget is not expenditure. Do not present as investment growth achieved.

Definition: Investment expenditure as a share of consolidated revenue.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Scope of the investment figure (group incl. acquired brands) is not stated. Qualified.

Definition: Planned investment as a share of the revenue target.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Budget over target; both unrealised.

Definition: Group revenue divided by the restaurant count.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: QUALIFIED: revenue also includes hotels, events and catering, and the count is from May 2024 and excludes cafes. Use for trend only.

Definition: Group revenue divided by restaurants and cafes.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Point-in-time count, full-year revenue. Qualified.

Definition: Internal consistency of company RON and EUR figures.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Compare with BNR 2023 average (MA-024).

Definition: Internal consistency of company RON and EUR figures.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: Compare with BNR 2024 average (MA-025).

Definition: Group operating profit is not published.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: No public group-level operating profit; do not infer from legal-entity filings.

Definition: Group consolidated net profit is not published.
Comparability_and_Use_Note: ZF's 'Grupul City Grill' figure (CF-043) is an unverified-entity Proxy; not used.
